learned_rule: best family by point-estimate Success in that bin, chosen before the bootstrap; families = M2-Track and MBPTrack on nuScenes Car (no yaw correction; frame-0 matches GT)
bins: single-axis point bins (<10, 10–24, ≥25) and motion bins (<2.5 m, ≥2.5 m); frame 0 excluded; no point-bin merge (GT census, already recorded)

kitti_side.verdict_text: KITTI side of rule: KILL conditions hold on every eligible decision bin (each bin with ≥20% of binned frames and ≥30 tracklets has learned − floor Success > 10 and a 95% lower bound > 5).

nuscenes_side.verdict_text: nuScenes side of rule: KILL conditions do not hold on every eligible decision bin. The pts0 (<10 points) bin is eligible (59.4% of binned frames, 3,304 tracklets) and has best-learned − floor Success 9.64 [7.97, 11.29], which is neither a KILL cell (gap not > 10) nor a GO cell. The other eligible bins (pts2, motLo) meet the KILL cell condition. No eligible bin meets the GO cell condition.

verdict_text: KITTI side of rule: KILL conditions hold on every eligible decision bin (each bin with ≥20% of binned frames and ≥30 tracklets has learned − floor Success > 10 and a 95% lower bound > 5). nuScenes side of rule: KILL conditions do not hold on every eligible decision bin. The pts0 (<10 points) bin is eligible (59.4% of binned frames, 3,304 tracklets) and has best-learned − floor Success 9.64 [7.97, 11.29], which is neither a KILL cell (gap not > 10) nor a GO cell. The other eligible bins (pts2, motLo) meet the KILL cell condition. No eligible bin meets the GO cell condition. The first-test rule returns INCONCLUSIVE. On KITTI Car, every eligible decision bin meets the KILL cell condition. On nuScenes Car, two eligible bins (pts2 / ≥25 points, and motLo / <2.5 m) also meet that condition, but the remaining eligible bin does not: pts0 (<10 points) holds 59.4% of binned frames (35,909 frames, 3,304 tracklets) and has best-learned (MBPTrack) − floor Success of 9.64 with 95% CI [7.97, 11.29]. That gap is not greater than 10, so the bin is not a KILL cell; it is also not a GO cell (gap is not ≤ 5, and the upper bound is not ≤ 10). The GO clause therefore does not fire (KITTI has no GO cell, including no ≥40% GO bin). Per the frozen pre-registration, TrackAny3D is to be added and the same rule re-applied once.

m2track_pts0_note: Per-family note, not used by the rule: M2-Track on the same pts0 bin has gap 1.49 with 95% CI [−0.29, 3.24], which would meet the GO cell condition.
